analysis.title: Market Rhythm
key_insights: Semi equipment's attempted V-shaped recovery has stalled. Price slipped back under the downtrend and is heading toward 7,000 support. Given its history as a lead indicator, EFG calls for increased caution.
S&P 500's pullback has resumed, with price leaning toward the 200dma and futures weaker. A falling RSI shows downside momentum is still in control.
VIX is rising within its uptrend and trades well above the 50dma after a big jump on 16 Nov and another strong open on 17 Nov. It is not yet overbought and signals uncertainty across risk assets.
Stoxx Europe 600 slipped back below the 663 pivot. Price and RSI are both still in uptrends, so EFG sees a possible minor setback but advises caution.
DAX tested 26,620 and now trades below it in a weak session. First support is 26,000, followed by the 50dma on deeper weakness.
Hang Seng is drifting toward the September downtrend and support near 22,935. Today's doji hints at a pause, but RSI remains in a downtrend and gives no contrarian signal.
TOPIX slipped back under the 200dma and is re-targeting the 3,700 area. RSI is below 50 and pointing lower, so the negative bias remains.

EURUSD (1.1010) broke below key 1.1100 support last week. Spot is near the dotted-line support at 1.0970, and the weekly chart shows an important point at 1.0950/40. The 1.0970 to 1.0940 area is a strong support zone.

USDCHF (0.8390) printed a fresh high early on 17 Nov, confirming positive momentum. It is approaching the upper channel line at 0.8445. That channel has driven the pair since mid-2022, which makes 0.8445/50 strong resistance.

sector_views.rationale: Attempted V-shaped recovery stalled, price back under the downtrend and heading toward 7,000 support. Its record as a lead indicator warrants more caution.

risk_factors: The S&P 500 pullback is resuming toward the 200dma with a falling RSI.
Semi equipment is a lead indicator and is weakening toward 7,000 support.
Europe and Asia indices are weakening: DAX below 26,620, TOPIX below its 200dma, Hang Seng drifting toward 22,935.
vol_and_positioning: VIX is trading well above its 50dma after a big jump on 16 Nov and another strong open on 17 Nov. It is not yet overbought and EFG reads it as continued uncertainty across risk assets.
